text:
maria: Customer on prod is seeing repeated 401s and occasional 500s for the same request IDs, plus high tail latency (~2s) on embeddings route. Need minimal repro snippets (curl/py/js/go) and a debug bundle. Request IDs: req_6a1b2c3d, req_6a1b2c4e. Trace: trace-000111222.

sam: thanks — can you paste the exact curl they used or a minimal curl that reproduces? also which SDK version and region?

maria: they said they hit via our python SDK v0.9.2 from us-west-2. Example call was a small batch of 4 embeddings, model: embed-large-v1. I asked for logs, they provided these snippets: `401 Unauthorized: token invalid` then `500 Internal Server Error` for the second req id.

jordan: pinging oncall, this smells like an auth token TTL edge case + request routing fallback. lee, any recent deploys to embed infra? :eyes: 

deploy-bot: deploy completed to embeds-prod (us-west-2) at 2026-03-14T18:22:10Z by ci/cd-pipeline #build-5412

lee: saw that deploy. No config changes to auth. Could be short-lived key rotation leak. Lee will grab logs.

alex: to collect a debug bundle from the customer ask for: 1) minimal curl reproducer, 2) python/js/go snippets, 3) output of `env | grep REDWOOD` (redact secrets), 4) connection debug logs (curl -v) and SDK debug flag output, 5) trace & req ids (we have those). Provide an upload link once they zip.

maria: putting together minimal snippets for them now. Sending snippets to paste in their environment.

maria: CURL snippet:
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"embed-large-v1","input":["hello","world","foo","bar"]}'
```

maria: Python snippet (requests):
```python
import os
import requests

API_KEY = os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")
url = "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings"
payload = {"model": "embed-large-v1", "input": ["hello","world","foo","bar"]}
resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"})
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```

maria: Node (fetch) snippet:
```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const url = 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings';
const apiKey = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;
const body = { model: 'embed-large-v1', input: ['hello','world','foo','bar'] };
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) })
  .then(r => r.text().then(t => console.log(r.status, t)))
  .catch(e => console.error(e));
```

maria: Go snippet (net/http):
```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
)
func main(){
  apiKey := os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")
  payload := []byte(`{"model":"embed-large-v1","input":["hello","world","foo","bar"]}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings", bytes.NewBuffer(payload))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+apiKey)
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
  if err!=nil{ fmt.Println("err", err); return }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  fmt.Println("status", resp.Status)
}
```

sam: good. Ask them to set SDK_DEBUG=1 and attach stdout. Also ask to run the curl with `-v` and paste headers (redact token).

maria: will do. Also requesting the following from customer: SDK version, region, exact timestamp window (we need server-side logs). I gave them the two req ids and trace.

lee: I'll search logs for those req ids and the trace once we have the timestamp. If we find a 401 from auth-service at the same time as a 500 from embed-worker, that's likely token routing mismatch.

alex: when they zip up the bundle, have them name it `support-2172223333-maria.zip` and upload to s3://redwood-debug-bundles/ or attach in the Zendesk ticket. If uploading to S3, tell them to set ACL private and paste the object path.

maria: customer replied with curl -v output and redacted headers. They saw a `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error=\"invalid_token\"` then later a `500` on retry.

jordan: can you include a forced reauth test: curl with an obviously wrong key to see if we get a deterministic 401, then curl with their key. Helps separate invalid token vs intermittent auth backend.

maria: note sent: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -> 401 as expected. Their real key sometimes 401s.

lee: I grabbed internal logs: for req_6a1b2c3d we saw auth-service reply 200 then embed-worker threw a 500 with throwable "kv-cache-miss" at 18:22:12. For req_6a1b2c4e we saw auth-service 401 at 18:22:15. Looks like a timing/routing mismatch across replicas.

sam: interesting. Could be cache invalidation during a config roll or stale credential replica. I'll run a smoke repro locally with the same SDK version and region and stress the auth flow.

maria: customer asked for a small script they can run to reproduce intermittency quickly — combined loop curl script I suggested:
```bash
for i in {1..20}; do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"embed-large-v1","input":["x"]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings || echo fail
  sleep 0.2
done
```

alex: once they hit a repro, ask them to immediately run `curl -v` on the failing request and upload the output. That gives us the exact server time and headers.

maria: customer uploaded support-2172223333-maria.zip to s3://redwood-debug-bundles/support-2172223333-maria.zip (private). I can pull it into the ticket.

lee: thanks — I'll correlate bundle time with auth logs. If this is a stale-replica issue we'll rota it through the infra team for a config sync.

jordan: also note: request-level caching can cause different worker behavior. If they used batching library it might alter prefix caching keys. Did they set batch_size?

maria: they used the SDK default batch path, batch_size unspecified. I'll ask them to try forcing single item per request as a quick test.

sam: next steps for engineering: 1) reproduce with local stress using SDK v0.9.2 in us-west-2, 2) check auth replica sync state around 18:22:10-18:22:20, 3) add temporary additional logging for cache misses on embed-workers for canary, 4) follow up in ticket with root cause and mitigation.

maria: relaying ETA to customer: we'll update within 3 hours after initial log correlation.

alex: tagging for handoff to infra if needed: @lee @sam @jordan — please update the ticket with findings.

lee: will do.

maria: thanks all, keeping ticket updated. :thumbsup:
